wiki_article:
**laborvector.org** is a software and executable apparatus deposit by Lee Sharks, dated 5 June 2026, holding the complete source of the canonical definition surface for **directionality of semantic labor**.

The archive maintains a family of single-concept sites — provenanceerasure.org, spxi.dev, persistentidentifiers.org, this one — each existing to give a term a stable, citable, machine-readable home. The reasoning is drawn from the archive's own research: a concept that lives only inside long documents is one a composition layer can paraphrase away, while a concept with a canonical definition surface has an address that survives summarization.

The body was recovered on 4 August 2026 from the live surface, with the served page's SHA-256 recorded so the capture is checkable against what the site actually returned. The deposit is the archival capture; the site remains the live manifestation.
